title: astracantha bethlehemitica
intro: Astracantha bethlehemitica, commonly known as Spiny Acacia or Acacia tree, is a plant species native to the Middle East and Mediterranean regions. This thorny shrub or small tree is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects, which may aid in wound healing and reducing oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Astracantha bethlehemitica include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects. The plant's therapeutic actions include analgesic, anti-diarrheal, and antipyretic properties, making it a potential natural remedy for various health conditions.
